hero.label: Frequently asked questions
hero.title: Straight answers about the Eduvixo platform.
hero.copy: The essentials for decision-makers, technical teams and organizations evaluating deployment.

items.question: Is Eduvixo only a CMS?
items.answer: No. Content management is the foundation, but Eduvixo also connects AI, institutional knowledge, AI Chat, Live Chat, teams, campuses, notifications, marketplace packages and multi-platform experiences.

items.question: Can we run Eduvixo on our own infrastructure?
items.answer: Yes. Eduvixo supports a self-hosted model for institutions that require direct control over infrastructure, configuration and data location.

items.question: Does Eduvixo support multiple campuses?
items.answer: Yes. One organization can manage multiple campuses, local identities and content scopes centrally, while location-aware discovery helps visitors reach the nearest relevant facility.

items.question: Does AI replace our staff?
items.answer: No. Eduvixo is designed for AI and people to work together. AI can handle approved repeatable questions, while conversations requiring judgment are transferred to human teams.

items.question: Can the AI assistant learn our institution?
items.answer: Yes. Approved organizational knowledge can be prepared for retrieval so the assistant's answers are grounded in your institution rather than generic assumptions.

items.question: How are themes and extensions installed?
items.answer: Marketplace packages use signed manifests, checksums, compatibility validation, protected staging and rollback-oriented installation controls.

items.question: Is the platform multilingual?
items.answer: Yes. The platform and this website are designed for multilingual institutions, localized content and language-aware public experiences.

items.question: Can Eduvixo grow with our organization?
items.answer: Yes. It can begin with one school and expand across campuses, departments, teams, communication channels and additional digital services.

hero.label: Privacy
hero.title: Clear information about website data.
hero.copy: This notice explains the limited information processed when you use the Eduvixo product website.

sections.title: Contact enquiries
sections.copy: When you submit the contact form, we process the details you provide solely to review and respond to your enquiry. The form is protected against automated abuse and is delivered to the Eduvixo contact team.

sections.title: Language preferences
sections.copy: A first-party cookie stores a selected or automatically detected language so the website can provide a consistent multilingual experience. It is not used for advertising.

sections.title: Technical security data
sections.copy: Short-lived, pseudonymous request information may be processed to rate-limit abuse and protect the website. We do not place advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

sections.title: Your request
sections.copy: For privacy questions or requests concerning submitted contact data, write to info@eduvixo.com.

sections.title: Optional analytics
sections.copy: Google Analytics is loaded only after your explicit consent. You can reject it or withdraw consent at any time using Analytics settings. No analytics data is sent before consent.
